competing_explanation: The policy may have been updated to a shorter or longer window, or 'standard items' may be defined in a way that excludes the claimed 30-day full-refund treatment.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery.
refutation_criterion: The current policy specifies a different return window, applies the 30-day window only to non-standard items, or imposes conditions that prevent standard items from receiving a full refund within 30 days.
